Hi Priya,

Thanks for flagging this. I’m sorry for the disruption—our team is looking into the API timeouts as a priority now. We’ve logged this against the incident and are checking the affected requests and recent changes.

If you can share any example timestamps, request IDs, or impacted endpoints, that would help us isolate the issue faster.

We’ll keep you updated as soon as we have more information.

Best,
Morgan
